description: This file implements the NSSCertDatabase class, providing certificate management functions such as listing, importing, deleting, and trust management for certificates using NSS libraries within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CertNotificationForwarder
classes.description: Helper class that observes NSSCertDatabase events and forwards notifications to CertDatabase.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase
classes.description: Implements certificate database operations such as listing, importing, deleting, and trust management using NSS.

methods.name: ListCertsInSlot
methods.description: Lists certificates in a specific slot.

methods.name: ListCertsInfo
methods.description: Lists detailed info of certificates, with options to include trust info.

methods.name: SetCertTrust
methods.description: Sets trust bits for a certificate.

methods.name: FindRootInList
methods.description: Finds the root certificate in a list.

methods.name: ImportUserCert
methods.description: Imports a user certificate from data or CERTCertificate object.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Imports CA certificates with trust settings.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Imports server certificates with trust settings.

methods.name: GetCertTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a certificate.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKey
methods.description: Deletes a certificate and its key.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a certificate and key.

methods.name: IsUntrusted
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is untrusted.

methods.name: IsWebTrustAnchor
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is a web trust anchor.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's slot is read-only.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's key is hardware-backed.
